'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[2022–2023 Russian strikes against Ukrainian infrastructure]]
***[[Russia]] launches [[drone warfare|drone]] and [[cruise missile]] strikes across the south and east of [[Ukraine]] with large explosions reported in the [[Dnipropetrovsk Oblast|Dnipropetrovsk]], [[Luhansk Oblast|Luhansk]], [[Mykolaiv Oblast|Mykolaiv]], and [[Zaporizhzhia Oblast|Zaporizhzhia]] [[Oblasts of Ukraine|oblasts]]. *[[Jihadist insurgency in Burkina Faso]]
**[[Médecins Sans Frontières]] (MSF) suspends its operations in north-west [[Burkina Faso]] following the killings of two of its [[Burkinabé nationality law|Burkinabé]] [[Humanitarian aid|aid worker]]s near [[Dédougou]]. [https://www.africanews.com/2023/02/09/msf-suspends-operations-in-northwest-burkina-faso-after-gunmen-kill-two-staff/ (Africanews)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2023 Turkey–Syria earthquake]]
**The death toll from the [[List of earthquakes in Turkey|earthquakes]] in [[Turkey]] and [[Syria]] increases to 21,051. [https://www.rfi.fr/en/international-news/20230209-death-toll-tops-20-000-from-turkey-syria-quake-as-hopes-fade (AFP via RFI)]
*Four people are killed and several houses and buildings are destroyed by a 5.1 magnitude earthquake in [[Papua (province)|Papua]], [[Indonesia]]. [https://www.thestar.com.my/aseanplus/2023/02/09/four-killed-buildings-damaged-as-earthquake-hits-eastern-indonesia (Xinhua via ''The Star'')]
*Seven people are killed and nine others are injured in a [[gas explosion]] at a [[residential building]] in [[Novosibirsk]], [[Russia]]. [https://apnews.com/article/russia-government-health-dedd86d97b6317069a0606c2a751e649 (AP)]
*Four people are injured after a [[PAC P-750 XSTOL|PAC 750-XL]] aircraft [[plane crash|crashes]] in [[Jiwaka Province]], [[Papua New Guinea]]. [https://www.thenational.com.pg/plane-crash-2/ (The National)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[Travel during the COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in South Korea]]
***[[South Korea]] resumes the issuance of short-term [[travel visa]]s to [[Chinese nationality law|Chinese citizens]] following a one-month suspension due to [[China]]'s [[COVID-19 pandemic in mainland China#December 2022-2023 surge|COVID-19 surge]]. [https://www.businesstimes.com.sg/international/south-korea-ends-covid-19-visa-restrictions-china-travellers (AFP via ''The Business Times'')]

'''International relations'''
*[[Belarus–Poland relations]]
**[[Poland]] announces the closure of a major [[Border control#Border checkpoints|border crossing]] with [[Belarus]] "until further notice" amid heightened tensions between the two countries. There are currently only two checkpoints open between the two nations. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/poland-close-belarus-border-crossing-until-further-notice-says-minister-2023-02-09/ (Reuters)] 

'''Law and crime'''
*[[2023 Turkey–Syria earthquake]]
**Three inmates are killed and 12 others are injured after soldiers open fire during a [[prison riot]] in [[Hatay Province]], [[Turkey]]. The prisoners were demanding to see their families who were affected by the recent earthquake. [https://www.duvarenglish.com/three-inmates-killed-in-prison-riot-in-turkeys-quake-hit-hatay-news-61801 (Gazete Duvar)]
*The [[government of Nicaragua]] releases 222 [[political prisoner]]s and sends them to the [[United States]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/nicaragua-government-frees-more-than-200-political-prisoners-local-media-2023-02-09/ (Reuters)]
